plain_english: Of letter with emission — emission-ending awareness make: by supportless mind, eternal brahman may be touched.
sanskrit_cite: varṇasya savisargasya visargāntaṃ citiṃ kuru | nirādhāreṇa cittena spṛśed brahma sanātanam

plain_english: Sky-formed one's own self should be meditated, by directions uncovered: supportless awareness-power — own form will show it then.
sanskrit_cite: vyomākāraṃ svam ātmānaṃ dhyāyed digbhir anāvṛtam | nirāśrayā citiḥ śaktiḥ svarūpaṃ darśayet tadā

plain_english: Something, a limb, pierced first — with sharp needle and such, then: right there, awareness yoked — in Bhairava, spotless going.
sanskrit_cite: kiṃcid aṅgaṃ vibhidyādau tīkṣṇasūcyādinā tataḥ | tatraiva cetanāṃ yuktvā bhairave nirmalā gatiḥ

plain_english: Mind-and-the-rest, inner-making, is not inside me: think thus — by absence of fancies, fancies abandoned may be.
sanskrit_cite: cittādyantaḥkṛtir nāsti mamāntar bhāvayed iti | vikalpānām abhāvena vikalpair ujjhito bhavet

plain_english: Māyā, the deluding one, named: the counting of the parts stands; counting the such-and-such natures of realities — not separately may be.
sanskrit_cite: māyā vimohinī nāma kalāyāḥ kalanaṃ sthitam | ityādidharmaṃ tattvānāṃ kalayan na pṛthag bhavet

plain_english: Sudden desire arisen — having seen it, to calm should lead it: where it indeed arose, there right there it dissolves.
sanskrit_cite: jhagitīcchāṃ samutpannām avalokya śamaṃ nayet | yata eva samudbhūtā tatas tatraiva līyate

plain_english: When my desire is unarisen — knowing, or what — then I am indeed: truly He-I, thus become, in that dissolved, that-minded may be.
sanskrit_cite: yadā mamecchā notpannā jñānaṃ vā kas tadāsmi vai | tattvato =B9haṃ tathābhūtas tallīnas tanmanā bhavet

plain_english: In desire or in knowing, when arisen — mind should be set: self-mind, undivided-minded — then the seeing of reality's meaning.
sanskrit_cite: icchāyām athavā jñāne jāte cittaṃ niveśayet | ātmabuddhyānanyacetās tatas tattvārthadarśanam

plain_english: Causeless may be the knowing, supportless, error-natured: truly not anyone's — thus becoming Śiva, O dear.
sanskrit_cite: nirnimittam bhavej jñānaṃ nirādhāram bhramātmakam | tattvataḥ kasyacin naitad evambhāvī śivaḥ priye

plain_english: Consciousness-natured in all bodies — distinction there is nowhere: hence, made of that, contemplating all — the world-conquering person.
sanskrit_cite: ciddharmā sarvadeheṣu viśeṣo nāsti kutracit | ataś ca tanmayaṃ sarvam bhāvayan bhavajij janaḥ
